  # E (top): Y changed from 1.0 to 3.0
  if(length(idx_e) > 0){
    Layout_Matrix[idx_e, 1] <- seq(-2.4, 2.4, length.out = length(idx_e))
    Layout_Matrix[idx_e, 2] <- 3.0 
  }
  # L (mid): Y stays 0.0
  if(length(idx_l) > 0){
    Layout_Matrix[idx_l, 1] <- seq(-1.6, 1.6, length.out = length(idx_l))
    Layout_Matrix[idx_l, 2] <- 0.0
  }
  # H (bottom): Y changed from -1.0 to -3.0
  if(length(idx_h) > 0){
    Layout_Matrix[idx_h, 1] <- seq(-0.8, 0.8, length.out = length(idx_h))
    Layout_Matrix[idx_h, 2] <- -3.0
  }

  # --- 6. Define communities ---
  groups_list <- list(
    "Environment" = idx_e,
    "Lifestyle"   = idx_l
  )
  groups_list[[model_label]] <- idx_h 
  
  # Colour matching
  my_colors <- c(
    if("Environment" %in% names(custom_node_colors)) custom_node_colors["Environment"] else "#A6CEE3",
    if("Lifestyle" %in% names(custom_node_colors)) custom_node_colors["Lifestyle"] else "#B2DF8A",
    if(model_label %in% names(custom_node_colors)) custom_node_colors[model_label] else "#FB9A99"
  )

  # --- 7. Plot (keeping your parameters exactly) ---
  tryCatch({
    pdf_name <- file.path(out_dir_dag, paste0("DAG_Layered2_", model_label, ".pdf"))
    pdf(pdf_name, width = 32, height = 16)
    
    qgraph(dag_adj, 
           layout = Layout_Matrix, 
           rescale = TRUE,
           
           # === Style ===
           edge.color = edge_col_mat, 
           groups = groups_list,
           color = my_colors, 
           labels = colnames(dag_adj), 
           
           vsize = 2.5,
           label.cex = 0.8,
           
           border.color = "gray30",
           nodeNames = NULL,
           legend = TRUE, 
           legend.cex = 0.5, 
           
           directed = TRUE,
           mode = "direct",
           esize = 1.2,
           asize = 2.0,
           
           curve = 0.3,     
           curveAll = TRUE,
           
           title = paste("DAG Structure (Layered):", model_label),
           title.cex = 1.6,
           mar = c(9, 5, 5, 3) 
    )
    
    mtext(param_label_1, side = 1, line = 3, adj = 0, cex = 0.85, col = "gray40", font = 3)
    mtext(param_label_2, side = 1, line = 4.5, adj = 0, cex = 0.85, col = "gray40", font = 3)
    
    dev.off()
    message(paste("   ✅ Layered Plot Saved (Vertical Spacing x3):", model_label))
    
  }, error = function(e){
    message(paste("   ❌ Error:", e$message))
    if(dev.cur() > 1) dev.off()
  })
}


# DAG_Spring_plot
```{r}
library(qgraph)
library(dplyr)
library(bnlearn)


# STEP 3: Final plotting (free layout + high-repulsion comparison)


FINAL_THRESHOLD <- 0.70 # or 0.90

# Labels
param_label_1 <- paste0("Threshold: ", FINAL_THRESHOLD, " | Layout: High Repulsion Spring")
param_label_2 <- "Green: Forward | Red: Feedback | Gray: Within-Group"

message(paste("\n🎨 [Step 3 Contrast] STARTING FORCE-DIRECTED PLOTTING | Threshold:", FINAL_THRESHOLD))

target_models <- names(multi_models) 

for(model_label in target_models){
  
  # --- 1. Read the raw data (unchanged) ---
  rds_file <- file.path(out_dir_dag, paste0("Boot_Object_", model_label, ".rds"))
  
  if(!file.exists(rds_file)){
    message(paste("⚠️ Skipped:", model_label, "(RDS not found)"))
    next
  }
  
  str_fit <- readRDS(rds_file)
  
  # --- 2. Filter edges ---
  avg_dag <- averaged.network(str_fit, threshold = FINAL_THRESHOLD)
  final_arcs <- as.data.frame(avg_dag$arcs)
  all_nodes <- nodes(avg_dag) 
  n_total <- length(all_nodes)
  
  # --- 3. Prepare matrices ---
  dag_adj <- matrix(0, nrow = n_total, ncol = n_total)
  rownames(dag_adj) <- colnames(dag_adj) <- all_nodes
  
  edge_col_mat <- matrix("black", nrow = n_total, ncol = n_total)
  rownames(edge_col_mat) <- colnames(edge_col_mat) <- all_nodes 
  
  # Group-assignment helper function
  get_group_id_safe <- function(node_name_clean){
    e_names_safe <- make.names(e_names)
    l_names_safe <- make.names(l_names)
    if(node_name_clean %in% e_names || node_name_clean %in% e_names_safe) return(1)
    if(node_name_clean %in% l_names || node_name_clean %in% l_names_safe) return(2)
    return(3) 
  }
  
  # --- 4. Fill matrices & colour edges ---
  if(nrow(final_arcs) > 0){
    for(i in 1:nrow(final_arcs)){
      f <- final_arcs[i, "from"]
      t <- final_arcs[i, "to"]
      
      if(f %in% all_nodes && t %in% all_nodes){
        dag_adj[f, t] <- 1
        
        g_src <- get_group_id_safe(f)
        g_dst <- get_group_id_safe(t)
        
        if(g_src == g_dst) edge_col_mat[f, t] <- "gray80"       
        else if(g_src < g_dst) edge_col_mat[f, t] <- "forestgreen" 
        else edge_col_mat[f, t] <- "firebrick2"  
      }
    }
  }

  # --- 5. Define communities (keep the index logic) ---
  group_ids <- sapply(all_nodes, get_group_id_safe)
  idx_e <- which(group_ids == 1)
  idx_l <- which(group_ids == 2)
  idx_h <- which(group_ids == 3)
  
  groups_list <- list("Environment" = idx_e, "Lifestyle" = idx_l)
  groups_list[[model_label]] <- idx_h 
  
  my_colors <- c(
    if("Environment" %in% names(custom_node_colors)) custom_node_colors["Environment"] else "#A6CEE3",
    if("Lifestyle" %in% names(custom_node_colors)) custom_node_colors["Lifestyle"] else "#B2DF8A",
    if(model_label %in% names(custom_node_colors)) custom_node_colors[model_label] else "#FB9A99"
  )

  # --- 6. Plot (free layout) ---
  tryCatch({
    pdf_name <- file.path(out_dir_dag, paste0("DAG_Spring_", model_label, ".pdf"))
    
    pdf(pdf_name, width = 32, height = 16)
    
    qgraph(dag_adj, 
           layout = "spring",
           layout.par = list(
             repulsion = 3.0,      # repulsion: very strong (default ~1), pushes nodes far apart
             area = n_total^3.5,   # area: large, lets nodes spread out fully
             cool.exp = 1.1,       # cooling exponent
             niter = 5000          # iterations: run longer for a more stable structure
           ),
           
           rescale = TRUE,
           
           # === Style (unchanged) ===
           edge.color = edge_col_mat, 
           groups = groups_list,
           color = my_colors, 
           labels = colnames(dag_adj), 
           
           vsize = 2.5,
           label.cex = 0.8,
           
           border.color = "gray30",
           nodeNames = NULL,
           legend = TRUE, 
           legend.cex = 0.5,
           
           directed = TRUE,
           mode = "direct",
           esize = 1.2,
           asize = 2.0,
           
           curve = 0.3,     
           curveAll = TRUE, 
           
           title = paste("DAG Structure (Free Spring Layout):", model_label),
           title.cex = 1.6,
           mar = c(9, 5, 5, 3)
    )
    
    mtext(param_label_1, side = 1, line = 3, adj = 0, cex = 0.85, col = "gray40", font = 3)
    mtext(param_label_2, side = 1, line = 4.5, adj = 0, cex = 0.85, col = "gray40", font = 3)
    
    dev.off()
    message(paste("   ✅ Spring Layout Plot Saved:", model_label))
    
  }, error = function(e){
    message(paste("   ❌ Error:", e$message))
    if(dev.cur() > 1) dev.off()
  })
}
```


# Summary: BGGM and DAG integration visulization
```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 0. Setup & global configuration
# ==============================================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(networktools) 
library(tibble)
library(ggalluvial)
library(bnlearn) # required for handling the RDS objects

# Path configuration
out_dir     <- out_fig_dir
# Important: make sure your .rds files (Boot_Object_...) are under out_fig_dir/DAG_Analysis
out_dir_dag <- file.path(out_fig_dir, "DAG_Analysis")

if(!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive=TRUE)

# Key: set the DAG threshold (must match the Step 3 plotting exactly)
DAG_THRESHOLD <- 0.70  

models <- c("Mental_Health", "Physical_Health", "Social_Health")

# --- Colour scheme ---
my_colors <- c(
  "Environment"     = "#AEC7E8",  
  "Lifestyle"       = "#98DF8A",  
  "Mental_Health"   = "#D8BFD8",  
  "Physical_Health" = "#FFBB78",  
  "Social_Health"   = "#FFB6C1"   
)


heatmap_neg <- "#CD5C5C" 
heatmap_mid <- "white"   
heatmap_pos <- "#2E8B57"


# ==============================================================================
# 🎯 Figure 3 Combined: Shared Y-Axis + Dual Bridge Asterisks
# ==============================================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(networktools)
library(tibble)
library(bnlearn)
library(patchwork)
library(scales) 


# Asterisk colours
color_env_bridge <- "#800080" # purple (Environment)
color_health_bridge <- "#0000FF" # blue (Health)

message("\n========== Generating Figure 3 (dual asterisks) ==========")

# --- Step 1: Gather all data and compute bridge centrality ---
list_edges <- list()
all_y_nodes <- c() 

for (model_label in models) {

# A. Read BGGM (auto-detect separator)
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  bggm_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) {
    message(paste0("Resid file not found, trying the NPN file..."))
    bggm_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  }
  
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) next

  first_line <- readLines(bggm_file, n = 1)
  
  raw_data <- read.csv(bggm_file, check.names = FALSE)
  
  if (ncol(raw_data) <= 1) {
    message(paste0("   CSV format looks wrong (<=1 column), trying semicolon (;)..."))
    raw_data <- read.csv(bggm_file, sep = ";", check.names = FALSE)
  }
  
  if (ncol(raw_data) <= 1) {
    message(paste0("   still unresolved, trying tab (\t)..."))
    raw_data <- read.table(bggm_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
  }

  # 5. Handle row names
  if (ncol(raw_data) > 1) {
    rownames(raw_data) <- raw_data[, 1]
    adj_mat <- as.matrix(raw_data[, -1])
  } else {
    message("   Serious error: could not parse data columns; check the CSV separator manually.")
    message(paste0("   first line of the file: ", first_line))
    next
  }

  
  # B. Bridge EI computation
  node_names <- colnames(adj_mat)
  communities_vec <- case_when(grepl("^E", node_names) ~ "Environment", grepl("^L", node_names) ~ "Lifestyle", TRUE ~ "Health")
  
  bridge_map <- tryCatch({
    bridge_res <- networktools::bridge(adj_mat, communities = communities_vec, useCommunities = "all", directed = FALSE)
    df_bridge <- data.frame(Node = node_names, Bridge_EI = bridge_res$`Bridge Expected Influence (1-step)`)
    
    # Keep the top 20%
    threshold <- quantile(df_bridge$Bridge_EI, 0.80, na.rm = TRUE) 
    setNames((df_bridge$Bridge_EI >= threshold) & (df_bridge$Bridge_EI > 0), df_bridge$Node)
    
  }, error = function(e) setNames(rep(FALSE, length(node_names)), node_names))
  
  # C. Read the DAG
  rds_file <- file.path(out_dir_dag, paste0("Boot_Object_", model_label, ".rds"))
  dag_keys <- character()
  dag_status <- "not found / failed to load"
  
  if (file.exists(rds_file)) {
    str_fit <- readRDS(rds_file)
    avg_dag <- averaged.network(str_fit, threshold = DAG_THRESHOLD)
    dag_arcs <- as.data.frame(avg_dag$arcs)
    if(nrow(dag_arcs) > 0) {
        # Build safe keys
        dag_keys <- paste0(make.names(dag_arcs$from), "->", make.names(dag_arcs$to))
        dag_status <- paste0("loaded (edges: ", nrow(dag_arcs), ")")
    } else {
        dag_status <- "loaded but no edges (threshold too high?)"
    }
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Data integrity check (diagnostic)
  # ============================================================
  message(paste0("\n--------------------------------------------------"))
  message(paste0("Checking model: [", model_label, "]"))
  message(paste0("   1. BGGM matrix: ", nrow(adj_mat), " rows x ", ncol(adj_mat), " cols"))
  message(paste0("   2. sample variable names: ", paste(head(node_names, 3), collapse=", ")))
  message(paste0("   3. DAG status: ", dag_status))
  
  if(length(dag_keys) > 0) {
      message(paste0("   4. sample DAG keys (make.names):"))
      message(paste0("      -> ", head(dag_keys, 2)))
  }
  message(paste0("--------------------------------------------------\n"))
  # ============================================================

  
# D. Build the data (robust version: direct matrix indexing)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Ensure it is a matrix
  adj_mat <- as.matrix(adj_mat)
  
  indices <- which(adj_mat != 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
  
  if (nrow(indices) > 0) {
    edges_df <- data.frame(
      V1_str = rownames(adj_mat)[indices[, 1]],
      V2_str = colnames(adj_mat)[indices[, 2]],
      Freq   = adj_mat[indices],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    edges_df <- data.frame(V1_str=character(), V2_str=character(), Freq=numeric())
  }

  edges_df <- edges_df %>% 
    mutate(
      Type_From = case_when(grepl("^E", .data$V1_str) ~ "E", grepl("^L", .data$V1_str) ~ "L", TRUE ~ "H"),
      Type_To   = case_when(grepl("^E", .data$V2_str) ~ "E", grepl("^L", .data$V2_str) ~ "L", TRUE ~ "H")
    ) %>%
    # keep cross-level edges only
    filter((Type_From == "E" & Type_To == "H") | (Type_From == "H" & Type_To == "E")) %>%
    mutate(
      Source = ifelse(Type_From == "E", V1_str, V2_str),
      Target = ifelse(Type_To == "H", V2_str, V1_str),
      
      Is_Env_Bridge = bridge_map[Source],
      Is_Health_Bridge = bridge_map[Target],

      Expected_Key = paste0(make.names(Source), "->", make.names(Target)),
      Reverse_Key  = paste0(make.names(Target), "->", make.names(Source)),
  
      Direction_Type = case_when(
        Expected_Key %in% dag_keys ~ "Expected (E->H)", 
        Reverse_Key %in% dag_keys ~ "Reverse (H->E)", 
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
  
  if (nrow(edges_df) > 0) {
    list_edges[[model_label]] <- edges_df
    all_y_nodes <- c(all_y_nodes, unique(edges_df$Source)) 
  }
}

unified_y_levels <- sort(unique(all_y_nodes))

# --- Step 2: Plot ---
plot_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(models)) {
  model_label <- models[i]
  if(is.null(list_edges[[model_label]])) next
  df_curr <- list_edges[[model_label]]
  clean_title <- gsub("_", " ", model_label)
  show_y_axis <- (i == 1)
  
  p <- ggplot(df_curr, aes(x = Target, y = Source)) + 
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
    
    # 1. Heatmap
    geom_tile(aes(fill = Freq), color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) + 
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = heatmap_neg, mid = heatmap_mid, high = heatmap_pos, 
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-0.1, 0.1), oob = scales::squish, name = "Partial Correlation") +
    
    # 2. Values (nudged down)
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Freq)), size = 2.8, color = "black", fontface = "bold", position = position_nudge(y = -0.15)) +
    
    # 3. Environment-factor asterisk (top-left, purple)
    geom_text(data = subset(df_curr, Is_Env_Bridge), 
              label = "*", color = color_env_bridge, size = 6, fontface = "bold",
              position = position_nudge(x = -0.3, y = 0.25)) +
    
    # 4. Health-factor asterisk (top-right, blue)
    geom_text(data = subset(df_curr, Is_Health_Bridge), 
              label = "*", color = color_health_bridge, size = 6, fontface = "bold",
              position = position_nudge(x = 0.3, y = 0.25)) +
    
    # 5. Direction marker (upper-centre)
    geom_point(aes(shape = Direction_Type), color = "black", size = 3, na.rm = TRUE, position = position_nudge(y = 0.15)) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Direction_Type, color = Direction_Type), size = 2, na.rm = TRUE, position = position_nudge(y = 0.15)) +
    
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Expected (E->H)" = 19, "Reverse (H->E)" = 17)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Expected (E->H)" = "#FFD700", "Reverse (H->E)" = "#CD5C5C")) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = unified_y_levels, drop = FALSE) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = if(show_y_axis) element_text(size = 9, color = "black") else element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = if(show_y_axis) element_text(size = 10, face="bold") else element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = if(show_y_axis) element_line() else element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal"
    ) +
    labs(title = clean_title, x = NULL, y = if(show_y_axis) "Environmental Factors" else NULL)
  
  plot_list[[model_label]] <- p
}

# --- Step 3: Assemble the panels ---
if (length(plot_list) > 0) {
  
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3) + 
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") + 
    plot_annotation(
      title = "Figure 3: Direct Pathways across Health Domains (Dual Bridge Markers)",
      subtitle = paste0("Note: Top-Left Purple '*' = Environment Bridge; Top-Right Blue '*' = Health Bridge.\n", "Color range [-0.1, 0.1]. Shapes indicate DAG direction."),
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray30")
      )
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Figure3_Combined_DualStars.pdf"), combined_plot, width = 18, height = 7)
  print(combined_plot)
  message("Figure 3 (dual stars) complete.")
  
} else {
  message("No data.")
}

# ==============================================================================
# Refined Figure 3: bubble matrix - red/green colour version
# ==============================================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(here)
library(networktools)

message("\n========== Generating the red/green bubble matrix ==========")

# --- 1. Paths and configuration ---
source_dir <- here::here("output")
save_dir   <- here::here("plot")
if(!dir.exists(save_dir)) dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)

models <- c("Mental_Health", "Physical_Health", "Social_Health")
color_env_bridge <- "#800080" 
color_health_bridge <- "#0000FF"

color_pos <- "#228B22"  # forest green (positive)
color_neg <- "#EE2C2C"  # firebrick red (negative)
color_mid <- "#F7F7F7"  # very light grey

plot_list <- list()

# --- 2. Loop ---
for (i in seq_along(models)) {
  model_label <- models[i]
  
  # A. Read data (brief)
  bggm_file <- file.path(source_dir, paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) bggm_file <- here::here("plot", paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) next
  raw_data <- read.csv(bggm_file, check.names = FALSE)
  if (ncol(raw_data) <= 1) raw_data <- read.csv(bggm_file, sep = ";", check.names = FALSE)
  if (ncol(raw_data) > 1) { rownames(raw_data) <- raw_data[, 1]; adj_mat <- as.matrix(raw_data[, -1]) } else next

  # B. Compute bridge centrality
  node_names <- colnames(adj_mat)
  communities_vec <- case_when(grepl("^E", node_names) ~ "Environment", grepl("^L", node_names) ~ "Lifestyle", TRUE ~ "Health")
  bridge_map <- tryCatch({
    bridge_res <- networktools::bridge(adj_mat, communities = communities_vec, useCommunities = "all", directed = FALSE)
    df_bridge <- data.frame(Node = node_names, Bridge_EI = bridge_res$`Bridge Expected Influence (1-step)`)
    threshold <- quantile(df_bridge$Bridge_EI, 0.80, na.rm = TRUE) 
    setNames((df_bridge$Bridge_EI >= threshold) & (df_bridge$Bridge_EI > 0), df_bridge$Node)
  }, error = function(e) setNames(rep(FALSE, length(node_names)), node_names))

  # C. Extract edge data
  indices <- which(adj_mat != 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
  if(nrow(indices) == 0) next
  df_curr <- data.frame(Source = rownames(adj_mat)[indices[, 1]], Target = colnames(adj_mat)[indices[, 2]], Freq = adj_mat[indices], stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(Type_From = case_when(grepl("^E", Source) ~ "E", grepl("^L", Source) ~ "L", TRUE ~ "H"),
           Type_To   = case_when(grepl("^E", Target) ~ "E", grepl("^L", Target) ~ "L", TRUE ~ "H")) %>%
    filter((Type_From == "E" & Type_To == "H") | (Type_From == "H" & Type_To == "E")) %>%
    mutate(Real_Source = ifelse(Type_From == "E", Source, Target), Real_Target = ifelse(Type_To == "H", Target, Source),
           Is_Env_Bridge = bridge_map[Real_Source], Is_Health_Bridge = bridge_map[Real_Target]) %>%
    select(Source = Real_Source, Target = Real_Target, Freq, Is_Env_Bridge, Is_Health_Bridge)

  if(nrow(df_curr) == 0) next
  
  # D. Plot (bubble plot)
  clean_title <- gsub("_", " ", model_label)
  show_y_axis <- (i == 1)
  
  p <- ggplot(df_curr, aes(x = Target, y = Source)) + 
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
    geom_tile(fill = NA, color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(size = abs(Freq), fill = Freq), shape = 21, color = "white", stroke = 0.5) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(6, 18), limits = c(0, 0.5), guide = "none") + 
    
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = color_neg, mid = color_mid, high = color_pos, 
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-0.25, 0.25), oob = scales::squish, 
                         name = "Partial Correlation") +
    
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Freq)), size = 3, fontface = "bold", 
              color = ifelse(abs(df_curr$Freq) > 0.15, "white", "black")) +
    geom_text(data = subset(df_curr, Is_Env_Bridge), label = "★", color = color_env_bridge, size = 5, vjust = 0.5, position = position_nudge(x = -0.35, y = 0.35)) +
    geom_text(data = subset(df_curr, Is_Health_Bridge), label = "★", color = color_health_bridge, size = 5, vjust = 0.5, position = position_nudge(x = 0.35, y = 0.35)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10, color = "black", face = "bold"),
          axis.text.y = if(show_y_axis) element_text(size = 10, color = "black", face = "bold") else element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
          panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8), legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(title = clean_title)
  
  plot_list[[model_label]] <- p
}

# --- 3. Assemble and save ---
if (length(plot_list) > 0) {
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") + 
    plot_annotation(
      title = "Figure 3: Bilateral Relationships (Bubble Matrix)",
      subtitle = "Bubble size = Magnitude; Color = Sign (Green = Positive, Red = Negative); ★ = Top 20% Bridge Node",
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))
    )
  out_pdf <- file.path(save_dir, "Figure3_Combined_BubbleStyle_GreenRed.pdf")
  ggsave(out_pdf, combined_plot, width = 18, height = 7)
  message(paste("Red/green bubble plot saved to:", out_pdf))
  print(combined_plot)
} else {
  message("No figure produced; check the data source.")
}



# ==============================================================================
# Final Figure 3B: bipartite network flow (sorted + green/red colour)
# ==============================================================================
# Fix: package name corrected to ggbump (all lowercase)
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Check and install (corrected package name)
if (!requireNamespace("ggbump", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ggbump")

# 2. Load packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(here)
library(ggbump) # <--- corrected to lowercase

message("\n========== Generating the red/green sorted flow plot ==========")

# --- 1. Paths and configuration ---
source_dir <- here::here("output")
save_dir   <- here::here("plot")
if(!dir.exists(save_dir)) dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)

models <- c("Mental_Health", "Physical_Health", "Social_Health")

# Colour scheme
color_pos <- "#228B22"  # forest green (positive)
color_neg <- "#EE2C2C"  # firebrick red (negative)
color_mid <- "grey90"   # midpoint colour

bipartite_list <- list()

# --- 2. Loop over each model ---
for (i in seq_along(models)) {
  model_label <- models[i]
  
  # A. Read data
  bggm_file <- file.path(source_dir, paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) bggm_file <- here::here("plot", paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) next

  raw_data <- read.csv(bggm_file, check.names = FALSE)
  if (ncol(raw_data) <= 1) raw_data <- read.csv(bggm_file, sep = ";", check.names = FALSE)
  if (ncol(raw_data) > 1) {
    rownames(raw_data) <- raw_data[, 1]
    adj_mat <- as.matrix(raw_data[, -1])
  } else next

  # B. Extract cross-level edges
  indices <- which(adj_mat != 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
  if(nrow(indices) == 0) next
  
  df_curr <- data.frame(
    Source = rownames(adj_mat)[indices[, 1]],
    Target = colnames(adj_mat)[indices[, 2]],
    Freq   = adj_mat[indices],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Type_From = case_when(grepl("^E", Source) ~ "E", grepl("^L", Source) ~ "L", TRUE ~ "H"),
      Type_To   = case_when(grepl("^E", Target) ~ "E", grepl("^L", Target) ~ "L", TRUE ~ "H")
    ) %>%
    filter((Type_From == "E" & Type_To == "H") | (Type_From == "H" & Type_To == "E")) %>%
    mutate(
      Real_Source = ifelse(Type_From == "E", Source, Target),
      Real_Target = ifelse(Type_To == "H", Target, Source)
    ) %>%
    select(Source = Real_Source, Target = Real_Target, Freq)

  if(nrow(df_curr) == 0) next

  # C. Sort by strength
  rank_source <- df_curr %>% group_by(Source) %>% summarise(Total_Weight = sum(abs(Freq))) %>% arrange(desc(Total_Weight))
  rank_target <- df_curr %>% group_by(Target) %>% summarise(Total_Weight = sum(abs(Freq))) %>% arrange(desc(Total_Weight))
  
  sorted_sources <- rank_source$Source
  sorted_targets <- rank_target$Target
  
  # Assign Y coordinates
  df_nodes_source <- data.frame(
    Label = sorted_sources, x = 0, 
    y = if(length(sorted_sources)>1) seq(0.9, 0.1, length.out = length(sorted_sources)) else 0.5
  )
  df_nodes_target <- data.frame(
    Label = sorted_targets, x = 1, 
    y = if(length(sorted_targets)>1) seq(0.9, 0.1, length.out = length(sorted_targets)) else 0.5
  )
  
  # Merge coordinates
  df_flow <- df_curr %>%
    left_join(df_nodes_source, by = c("Source" = "Label")) %>% rename(x_start = x, y_start = y) %>%
    left_join(df_nodes_target, by = c("Target" = "Label")) %>% rename(x_end = x, y_end = y)
  
  p_flow <- ggplot() +
    # sigmoid curve
    ggbump::geom_sigmoid(data = df_flow, 
                         aes(x = x_start + 0.02, y = y_start, xend = x_end - 0.02, yend = y_end, 
                             color = Freq, linewidth = abs(Freq)),
                         alpha = 0.8, smooth = 8, direction = "x") +
    # nodes
    geom_point(data = df_nodes_source, aes(x = x, y = y), size = 5, shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "black", stroke = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = df_nodes_target, aes(x = x, y = y), size = 5, shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "black", stroke = 0.8) +
    # Labels
    geom_text(data = df_nodes_source, aes(x = x - 0.05, y = y, label = Label), hjust = 1, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
    geom_text(data = df_nodes_target, aes(x = x + 0.05, y = y, label = Label), hjust = 0, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
    # values
    geom_text(data = df_flow, 
              aes(x = (x_start + x_end)/2, y = (y_start + y_end)/2 + 0.02, 
                  label = sprintf("%.2f", Freq), color = Freq), 
              size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", check_overlap = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE) +
    
    # red/green colours
    scale_color_gradient2(low = color_neg, mid = color_mid, high = color_pos, 
                          limits = c(-0.25, 0.25), name = "Partial Corr.") +
    scale_linewidth(range = c(0.8, 4), guide = "none") +
    
    xlim(-0.4, 1.4) + ylim(-0.05, 1.05) + 
    labs(title = gsub("_", " ", model_label)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 10)), plot.margin = margin(t = 20, b = 10))

  bipartite_list[[model_label]] <- p_flow
}

# --- 3. Assemble and save ---
if (length(bipartite_list) > 0) {
  
  # 1. Combine the panels
  p_combined_flow <- wrap_plots(bipartite_list, ncol = 3) + 
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "Figure 3B: Bipartite Network Flow (Sorted by Strength)",
      subtitle = "Nodes ordered by total strength. Color indicates sign (Green = Positive, Red = Negative).",
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray30")
      )
    )
  
  # 2. Set the save path
  out_pdf <- file.path(save_dir, "Figure3B_Bipartite_Flow_Sorted_GreenRed.pdf")
  
  # 3. Save
  ggsave(out_pdf, p_combined_flow, width = 18, height = 8)
  
  message(paste("Red/green flow plot saved to:", out_pdf))
  print(p_combined_flow)
  
} else {
  message("No figure produced; check the data source.")
}

# ==============================================================================
# Figure 3B: bipartite Sankey / alluvial flow plot
# ==============================================================================
# Core design:
# 1. Follow the Sankey style of Figure 4 (ggalluvial).
# 2. Left stratum = environment factors (E); right stratum = health factors (H).
# 3. Bar height = sum of all edge strengths at that node (reflects "volume").
# 4. Band colour: red = negative, green = positive.
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Check and install ggalluvial
if (!requireNamespace("ggalluvial", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ggalluvial")

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(here)
library(ggalluvial) # core plotting package

message("\n========== Generating Figure 3B (Sankey style) ==========")

# --- 1. Paths and configuration ---
source_dir <- here::here("output")
save_dir   <- here::here("plot")
if(!dir.exists(save_dir)) dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)

models <- c("Mental_Health", "Physical_Health", "Social_Health")

# Colours: red = negative, green = positive
color_pos <- "#228B22"  # Forest Green
color_neg <- "#EE2C2C"  # Firebrick Red

plot_list <- list()

# --- 2. Loop over each model ---
for (model_label in models) {
  
  # A. Read data
  bggm_file <- file.path(source_dir, paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) bggm_file <- here::here("plot", paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) next

  raw_data <- read.csv(bggm_file, check.names = FALSE)
  if (ncol(raw_data) <= 1) raw_data <- read.csv(bggm_file, sep = ";", check.names = FALSE)
  if (ncol(raw_data) > 1) {
    rownames(raw_data) <- raw_data[, 1]
    adj_mat <- as.matrix(raw_data[, -1])
  } else next

  # B. Extract cross-level edges (E <-> H)
  indices <- which(adj_mat != 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
  if(nrow(indices) == 0) next
  
  df_curr <- data.frame(
    Source = rownames(adj_mat)[indices[, 1]],
    Target = colnames(adj_mat)[indices[, 2]],
    Freq   = adj_mat[indices],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Type_From = case_when(grepl("^E", Source) ~ "E", grepl("^L", Source) ~ "L", TRUE ~ "H"),
      Type_To   = case_when(grepl("^E", Target) ~ "E", grepl("^L", Target) ~ "L", TRUE ~ "H")
    ) %>%
    filter((Type_From == "E" & Type_To == "H") | (Type_From == "H" & Type_To == "E")) %>%
    mutate(
      Real_Source = ifelse(Type_From == "E", Source, Target),
      Real_Target = ifelse(Type_To == "H", Target, Source)
    ) %>%
    select(Source = Real_Source, Target = Real_Target, Freq) %>%
    # add sign labels for fill colour
    mutate(
      Direction = ifelse(Freq > 0, "Positive (+)", "Negative (-)"),
      Abs_Freq  = abs(Freq) # used for width mapping
    )

  if(nrow(df_curr) == 0) next

  # C. Plot (using ggalluvial)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  clean_title <- gsub("_", " ", model_label)
  
  p <- ggplot(df_curr,
              aes(axis1 = Source, axis2 = Target, y = Abs_Freq)) + # y maps to the absolute value, driving bar height
    
    # 1. Flow layer (alluvium)
    geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Direction), 
                  width = 1/6,       # stratum width
                  alpha = 0.7,       # transparency (the desired overlay effect)
                  curve_type = "sigmoid") + # smooth sigmoid curve
    
    # 2. Stratum layer - bar height equals the aggregated volume
    geom_stratum(width = 1/6, fill = "grey95", color = "grey30") +
    
    # 3. Text labels
    geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), 
              size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
    
    # 4. Style settings
    scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Environment", "Health Outcome"), expand = c(0.1, 0.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Positive (+)" = color_pos, "Negative (-)" = color_neg)) +
    
    labs(title = clean_title, 
         y = "Total Connection Strength (|r| sum)", 
         fill = "Correlation") +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(), # hide Y ticks; only relative height matters
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  plot_list[[model_label]] <- p
}

# --- 3. Assemble and save ---
if (length(plot_list) > 0) {
  
  library(patchwork)
  
  # 1. Combine the panels
  p_combined <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3) + 
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "Figure 3B: Bipartite Network Flow (Sankey Style)",
      subtitle = "Bar height represents total connection strength. Band width represents individual correlation magnitude.",
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom" # set the legend position here
      )
    )
  
  # 2. Save
  out_pdf <- file.path(save_dir, "Figure3B_Bipartite_Sankey.pdf")
  ggsave(out_pdf, p_combined, width = 18, height = 8)
  
  message(paste("Sankey-style bipartite plot saved to:", out_pdf))
  print(p_combined)
  
} else {
  message("No figure produced; check the data source.")
}
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 3. Figure 6: DAG summary (reads RDS directly)
# ==============================================================================
message("\n========== Generating Figure 6 (DAG summary) ==========")

list_dag_summary <- list()

for (model_label in models) {
  bggm_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) next
  adj_mat <- as.matrix(read.csv(bggm_file, row.names = 1))
  
  edges_bggm <- as.data.frame(as.table(adj_mat)) %>%
    filter(Freq != 0, abs(Freq) > 0.02) %>%
    rename(Node1 = Var1, Node2 = Var2) %>%
    mutate(
      Type1 = case_when(grepl("^E", Node1)~"E", grepl("^L", Node1)~"L", grepl("^[MPS]", Node1)~"H", TRUE~"O"),
      Type2 = case_when(grepl("^E", Node2)~"E", grepl("^L", Node2)~"L", grepl("^[MPS]", Node2)~"H", TRUE~"O")
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(Key = paste(sort(c(as.character(Node1), as.character(Node2))), collapse = "|")) %>%
    ungroup() %>% distinct(Key, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # --- Key change: read the RDS ---
  rds_file <- file.path(out_dir_dag, paste0("Boot_Object_", model_label, ".rds"))
  dag_keys <- character()
  
  if (file.exists(rds_file)) {
    str_fit <- readRDS(rds_file)
    avg_dag <- averaged.network(str_fit, threshold = DAG_THRESHOLD)
    dag_arcs <- as.data.frame(avg_dag$arcs)
    if(nrow(dag_arcs) > 0){
      from_safe <- make.names(dag_arcs$from)
      to_safe   <- make.names(dag_arcs$to)
      dag_keys  <- paste0(from_safe, "->", to_safe)
    }
  }

classify_edge <- function(n1, n2, t1, t2) {
      s1 <- make.names(n1)
    s2 <- make.names(n2)

    if(setequal(c(t1,t2), c("E","L"))) { 
      p="E-L"; 
      exp=paste0(ifelse(t1=="E",s1,s2),"->",ifelse(t1=="L",s1,s2)); 
      rev=paste0(ifelse(t1=="L",s1,s2),"->",ifelse(t1=="E",s1,s2)) 
    }
    else if(setequal(c(t1,t2), c("L","H"))) { 
      p="L-H"; 
      exp=paste0(ifelse(t1=="L",s1,s2),"->",ifelse(t1=="H",s1,s2)); 
      rev=paste0(ifelse(t1=="H",s1,s2),"->",ifelse(t1=="L",s1,s2)) 
    }
    else if(setequal(c(t1,t2), c("E","H"))) { 
      p="E-H"; 
      exp=paste0(ifelse(t1=="E",s1,s2),"->",ifelse(t1=="H",s1,s2)); 
      rev=paste0(ifelse(t1=="H",s1,s2),"->",ifelse(t1=="E",s1,s2)) 
    }
    else return(NULL)
    
    stat <- "Undirected (BGGM Only)"
    if(exp %in% dag_keys) stat <- "Directed (Expected)"
    else if(rev %in% dag_keys) stat <- "Directed (Reverse)"
    return(data.frame(Domain=p, Status=stat))
}

  res_list <- list()
  for(i in 1:nrow(edges_bggm)) res_list[[i]] <- classify_edge(as.character(edges_bggm$Node1[i]), as.character(edges_bggm$Node2[i]), edges_bggm$Type1[i], edges_bggm$Type2[i])
  df_sum <- bind_rows(res_list)
  if(nrow(df_sum)>0) { df_sum$Model <- model_label; list_dag_summary[[model_label]] <- df_sum }
}

df_fig6 <- bind_rows(list_dag_summary)
if(nrow(df_fig6)>0) {
  p6 <- ggplot(df_fig6, aes(x=Domain, fill=Status)) +
    geom_bar(position="stack", width=0.6) +
    geom_text(stat='count', aes(label=after_stat(count)), position=position_stack(vjust=0.5), color="white", size=3) +
    facet_wrap(~Model, scales="free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("Directed (Expected)"="#2E8B57", "Directed (Reverse)"="#CD5C5C", "Undirected (BGGM Only)"="#A9A9A9")) +
    labs(title="Figure 6: Summary of Causal Directions", subtitle=paste0("Threshold: ", DAG_THRESHOLD, " (RDS Source)"), x="Domain Pair", y="Edge Count") +
    theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position="bottom")
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Figure6_DAG_Summary.pdf"), p6, width=12, height=8)
  print(p6)
  message("Figure 6 complete.")
}

# ==============================================================================
# 4. Figure 4: indirect pathways (reads RDS directly)
# ==============================================================================
message("\n========== Generating Figure 4 (indirect pathways) ==========")

list_indirect <- list()

for (model_label in models) {
  bggm_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) next
  adj_mat <- as.matrix(read.csv(bggm_file, row.names = 1))
  
  # --- Key change: read the RDS ---
  rds_file <- file.path(out_dir_dag, paste0("Boot_Object_", model_label, ".rds"))
  dag_keys <- character()
  
  if (file.exists(rds_file)) {
    str_fit <- readRDS(rds_file)
    avg_dag <- averaged.network(str_fit, threshold = DAG_THRESHOLD)
    dag_arcs <- as.data.frame(avg_dag$arcs)
    if(nrow(dag_arcs) > 0){
      from_safe <- make.names(dag_arcs$from)
      to_safe   <- make.names(dag_arcs$to)
      dag_keys  <- paste0(from_safe, "->", to_safe)
    }
  }
  
  # Build the base edge list
  edges_bggm <- as.data.frame(as.table(adj_mat)) %>%
    filter(Freq != 0, abs(Freq) > 0.00) %>%
    mutate(Strength = abs(Freq)) %>%
    mutate(
      Type1 = case_when(grepl("^E", Var1)~"E", grepl("^L", Var1)~"L", grepl("^[MPS]", Var1)~"H", TRUE~"Other"),
      Type2 = case_when(grepl("^E", Var2)~"E", grepl("^L", Var2)~"L", grepl("^[MPS]", Var2)~"H", TRUE~"Other"))

path_EL <- edges_bggm %>%
    filter((Type1 == "E" & Type2 == "L") | (Type1 == "L" & Type2 == "E")) %>%
    mutate(S = ifelse(Type1=="E", as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)),
           T = ifelse(Type1=="L", as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)),
           Key = paste0(make.names(S), "->", make.names(T))) %>%  
    select(S, T, Strength, Key) %>% rename(E=S, L=T, Str1=Strength, Key1=Key)

path_LH <- edges_bggm %>%
    filter((Type1 == "L" & Type2 == "H") | (Type1 == "H" & Type2 == "L")) %>%
    mutate(S = ifelse(Type1=="L", as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)),
           T = ifelse(Type1=="H", as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)),
           # apply make.names
           Key = paste0(make.names(S), "->", make.names(T))) %>% 
    select(S, T, Strength, Key) %>% rename(L=S, H=T, Str2=Strength, Key2=Key)
  
  full_path <- inner_join(path_EL, path_LH, by = "L") %>%
    mutate(
      Conf1 = Key1 %in% dag_keys,
      Conf2 = Key2 %in% dag_keys,
      Validation = case_when(
        Conf1 & Conf2 ~ "Strong Chain (Both Steps DAG Verified)",
        Conf1 | Conf2 ~ "Partial Chain (One Step DAG Verified)",
        TRUE ~ "Associational Chain (BGGM Only)"),
      
      Width = (Str1 + Str2)/2,
      Model = model_label
    )
  list_indirect[[model_label]] <- full_path
}

df_indirect <- bind_rows(list_indirect)

if (nrow(df_indirect) > 0) {
  df_indirect_viz <- df_indirect %>% filter(Width > 0.00) 
  
  if(nrow(df_indirect_viz) > 0) {
    p4 <- ggplot(df_indirect_viz, aes(axis1 = E, axis2 = L, axis3 = H, y = Width)) +
      geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Validation), width = 1/12, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_stratum(width = 1/6, fill = "grey95", color = "grey20") +
      geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 2.5) +
      scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Environment", "Lifestyle Mediator", "Health Outcome"), expand = c(.05, .05)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Strong Chain (Both Steps DAG Verified)"="#2E8B57", 
                                   "Partial Chain (One Step DAG Verified)"="#EEB422", 
                                   "Associational Chain (BGGM Only)"="#B0C4DE")) +
      facet_wrap(~Model, scales = "free") +
      labs(title = "Figure 4: Indirect Pathways (E->L->H)", 
           subtitle = paste0("Threshold: ", DAG_THRESHOLD, " (RDS Source)"),
           fill = "Causal Evidence") +
      theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face="bold"))
    
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Figure4_Indirect_Alluvial.pdf"), p4, width = 16, height = 10)
    print(p4)
    message("Figure 4 complete.")
  }
} else {
  message("Figure 4 not produced: no qualifying pathways found.")
}

message("\nAll figures updated; direct-RDS mode complete.")
```
